name: RL Unplugged
description: A collection of offline reinforcement-learning datasets comprising experience gathered from a range of environments and behavior policies, intended for evaluating and training data-driven reinforcement-learning methods. This is a dataset collection, not a single table or environment suite.
citation: Gulcehre, C., Wang, Z., Novikov, A., et al. (2020). RL Unplugged: A Suite of Benchmarks for Offline Reinforcement Learning. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 33. https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.13888
